role: HomeSI portal tile registry over the appliance config portals block

evolution.missing_field_semantics: Absent or null portals block projects the Manual factory tile without a write; absent port and health project null

changed.description: Mutation-only result; false for an idempotent upsert or absent deletion

url.description: A local root-relative path or an http/https URL without embedded credentials

health.description: Optional health URL/path metadata only; the registry never probes it

storage.shape: Object with tiles array; unknown block and tile fields survive mutations; the first effective write materializes the Manual tile and the requested change

canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, two-space indentation and one trailing LF. GET schema serves these exact file bytes.
